identity.name: DLL Search Order Hijacking via Malicious DLL Placement
identity.summary: An attacker places a malicious DLL in a directory that is searched before legitimate system directories, then executes a process that loads the hijacked DLL. Cortex should detect the process start and
identity.description: An attacker places a malicious DLL in a directory that is searched before legitimate system directories, then executes a process that loads the hijacked DLL. Cortex should detect the process start and file access behavior associated with DLL search order hijacking.

techniques.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location

payload.code:
cd C:\Users\Public
mkdir temp_dll
$malware = 'C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe'
$malware | Out-File -FilePath C:\Users\Public\temp_dll\msvcr120.dll
$cmd = 'C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe'
& $cmd

expected_artifacts.description: Malicious DLL placed in a directory that is searched before system directories
Process execution that loads the hijacked DLL

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious DLL Load from Non-Standard Directory
biocs.description: Process starts and loads a DLL from a non-standard directory that is searched before system directories
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'temp_dll'

abiocs.name: Process Load of Hijacked DLL
abiocs.description: A process loads a DLL from a directory that is not in the standard system path, indicating potential DLL hijacking
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_file_path contains 'temp_dll'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect Process Loading Hijacked DLL
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_file_path contains 'temp_dll'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe'
| fields actor_process_image_name, action_file_path
